scopeTemplate.notes: Desk review of a previously collected, authorized evidence pack. No new target interaction happens under this template.
boundaries: This template authorizes review only — never new scanning or browsing.
Evidence stays in approved storage; no copies to personal devices.
Redact personal data that is not needed for the conclusion.

checklist.item: Confirm the pack inventories every claimed observation with timestamps.
Check each conclusion traces to a specific recorded observation.
Verify the original authorization covered the pack's targets and dates.
Confirm personal data is redacted or justified before sharing.
Record open questions instead of guessing at missing evidence.
